spans.label: Imported crate types, plonky2 builder API and serde
spans.note: AccountState / SpendPublicInputs / ChannelId / PublicState / Tx / TxV2 / Merkle proofs / PoseidonHashOut / add_proof_target_and_verify are imported. Tx and PublicState reuse the registered Spend and BalancePublicInputs models; Merkle roots and the spend verifier are the opaque callbacks of Environment; plonky2 lowering is FieldAndGadgetLowering. No hash injectivity or proof soundness is assumed. The imported PoseidonHashOut interface (line 19) brings in TWO distinct Bytes32 readings, both modeled here: the partial TryFrom<Bytes32> of src/utils/poseidon_hash_out.rs:291-303, which tests each recombined u64 against GOLDILOCKS_ORDER first (firstNonCanonicalIndex) and only then round-trips the bytes (Bytes32.tryToHashOut, ConversionFault), and the total lossy Bytes32::reduce_to_hash_out. The listed theorems are about that imported interface premise only, not about any line of tx_settlement.rs.

boundaries.name: poseidon-merkle-roots
boundaries.obligation: Environment.txRoot / txV2Root / sendRoot / channelRoot are opaque callbacks; Poseidon collision resistance, hash injectivity and Merkle-gadget lowering equal to the native hash are never proved. Root equality is the only fact used.

boundaries.name: spend-proof-verifier
boundaries.obligation: spend_vd.verify / add_proof_target_and_verify with the pinned spend verifier key is Environment.spendVerifies; the model records the verdict only. Proof soundness and key pinning are not assumed or proved.

boundaries.name: canonical-roots
boundaries.obligation: CanonicalRoots: Poseidon Merkle roots are canonical Goldilocks elements (to_canonical_u64). This premise, not any conversion check, is the only thing that makes the native path at line 155 reject a non-canonical tx-tree root: line 155 uses the total, many-to-one Bytes32::reduce_to_hash_out, so the canonicality test added to TryFrom<Bytes32> in src/utils/poseidon_hash_out.rs never runs on this path.

boundaries.name: to-hash-out-gadget-lowering
boundaries.obligation: ToHashOutGates is the semantic content of Bytes32Target::to_hash_out (split_low_high plus the hi = 2^32-1 side constraint); the plonky2 lowering of that gadget to constraints is not proved.

boundaries.name: field-and-gadget-lowering
boundaries.obligation: FieldAndGadgetLowering: connect, is_equal, conditional_assert_eq, add_virtual_bool_target_safe, range checks and conditional_verify are assumed to enforce exactly the CircuitGates equations for every witness the builder accepts.

boundaries.name: native-type-ranges
boundaries.obligation: NativeTyped: the Rust types ChannelId (u32), BlockNumber (u63), Bytes32 limbs (u32) and the leaf indices respect their ranges; enforced by the imported types, not here.

boundaries.name: spend-nonce-word-domain
boundaries.obligation: SpendNonceWordTyped: the spend proof public-input nonce word is below 2^32. Natively the parser truncates with as u32 while the circuit connects the raw wire; the native-to-circuit bridge needs this premise.

boundaries.name: no-safety-claim
boundaries.obligation: No signature validity, finality, freshness or acceptance-implies-funds-safe statement is made; the model only relates the accepted tx to the committed account root.
